headline: Gutter Erupts as Palantine Berm Sees Renewed Fighting
war_summary: The night wire brings a new centre of action in Gutter, which posts thirteen changes in the last two hours and nineteen on the day around Lost Kaivo, Kuoppa and three other bases, standing one Warden to six Colonial, while Palantine Berm stirs anew with four changes in two hours and thirty-one on the day around Windburn Landing and Vendett, now two Warden to three Colonial with two neutral, and Weathered Expanse quickens to six in two hours and twenty-two on the day around Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest, now four Warden to three Colonial with two neutral. Linn Mercy adds two in two hours and twenty-two on the day around Outwich Ranch and Lathair, held two Warden to eight Colonial with one neutral, and Nevish Line adds two in two hours and eighteen on the day around Blackcoat Way, now six Warden to one Colonial with one neutral. Marban Hollow cools to one in two hours though six in six around Oster Wall, while Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf show no flips in two hours and Callahan's Passage again posts heavy casualties without a flip.
